faq.title: Quick Help & FAQ
faq.subtitle: Common questions about KHAAD BHARAT products, dealer terms, and farm support.
faq.a1: You can reach our support team via phone at +91 9625900369, by filling the contact form, or emailing contact@khaadbharat.com.
faq.q2: How long does it take to get a response?
faq.a2: Our typical response time is within 24 hours for business inquiries and 24 to 48 hours for general farm support.
faq.a3: Yes, we are actively onboarding distributors. Select 'Distributor Inquiry' in the contact form, and our onboarding team will follow up.
faq.q4: How can I request product information?
faq.a4: You can download our digital brochures from the Media page, or fill out the form specifying the pack size (5kg, 20kg, 50kg) you are interested in.
